title: RayuCode v3 native Rust release
highlights: Ship RayuCode v3 as a native Rust CLI, distributed as verified cross-platform binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows on x86_64 and aarch64
Publish verified cross-platform binaries directly on GitHub Releases (`Choeng-Rayu/rayucode-v2`), with SHA-256 checksums verified by every installer and by `rayu update`
Migrate existing Node v2 users automatically: the one-time bridge installs v3, preserves the old CLI as `rayu-legacy`, and offers to remove it
improvements: Serve `/install`, `/install.sh`, `/install.ps1`, `/cli-update.json`, and the legacy Node installers from rayucode.com with byte-identical copies of the repository scripts
Add public release CI that compiles all six Linux, macOS, and Windows targets natively on free GitHub Actions runners and verifies anonymous downloads with no GitHub token
Add a Rayu-only build mode via `ENABLE_OTHER_PROVIDER`
Add user agent profiles and per-task worker models, with each swarm worker's model shown in pinned tasks
Add transcript inspection and search, plus detailed per-tool transcripts
Stream Bash telemetry with compact task progress and per-row metrics
Add a shared UI package, an SDK browser subpath, bridge install, and a VS Code baseline
Add multi-product developer guides for CLI, Desktop, VS Code, Web, and shared packages
fixes: Fix pinned task and turn status ordering in the TUI
Fix lost turn telemetry and transcript details across turns and cancelled batches
Fix Telegram pairing and tool approvals drifting from the terminal session
Fix agent profiles being withheld or desynced across remote TUI sessions
Make `list_models` routes capped and filtered so profiles are never dropped
Fix missing tool-row metrics, native search result counts, and Bash previews
Fix the fullscreen composer position and theme previews on short terminals
Fix draft stash losing complete composer state
